decisions.reason: The color-matching workflow does not alter the basket-weave design attributes; the same message's scale and mustard-edge changes are already represented separately.
The shared color-matching workflow leaves the zebra palette and design requirements unchanged; the black-border change from this message is already represented.
Using an available supplier ICC profile or standard CMYK is a color-management method and does not change the requirement to deliver production-ready artwork files.

The client mentions a supplied terracotta Pantone while asking whether the later block version is possible, but this does not necessarily change the candidate's current design state at this time; the accepted matching workflow remains owned by the color-specification requirement.

The supplied mustard Pantone may refine color execution later, but the message does not change the current mustard interior-color requirement; the matching workflow is already represented by the source requirement.
